info.title: Orbit Gateway API Public SDK
info.description:
HTTP contract exposed by an Orbit gateway for local nodes, agents, apps, workspaces, processes, and control-plane operations.

Filtered for generated public SDK clients from apps/gateway/openapi-sdk-surface.json.
